sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile, Auditory, Unaware), Fuinjutsu

system.description:
You cause a psychotic break in the mind of your foe, making them lash out at their friends. Select one creature you can see within range, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw.

Critical Success: No further effects.

Success: Targets take 2d6 psychic damage.

Failure: The target must make take the Attack or Multiattack action, targeting one of its allies within its attack range and they gain 1 Mental Overwrite.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the target can now move as part of their failure, moving up to their speed towards the closest allied creature to them, ending that movement in a space that can hold them adjacent or as close as possible to the allied creature, and then attacking.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of creatures you can target by +1.
